title: The Power of Intercession in Every Season
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the importance of prayer in the life of a believer, specifically the role of intercession in pushing back darkness and experiencing God's freedom and breakthrough in our lives. By examining the biblical model of prayer, Pastor Chris will inspire and equip you to deepen your prayer life and become a strong intercessor, laboring in the Holy Spirit on behalf of others. Whether you're a seasoned prayer warrior or just starting out, this sermon is for you!
